# console-1.2 run mp-host-relay: mp18: HOST A ROOM alone, RELAY ONLY: the TURN relay is allocated (TURN reachability), cancel
# np-player.txt written by 1.3.0 build console-kit (the kit's files are not old settings files: the stale-settings guard leaves them as they are)
# tier 3, group mp18, route onhostwait, version payload 1.3, role ab
# mp18: as mp-host with RELAY ONLY (MSC_NET_RELAY_ONLY=1, the Settings choice): the room asks the service for TURN credentials and allocates a relay before it publishes anything: `relay: allocating on <server>` then `relay ready: <address>` = the TURN relay is reachable from this Wi-Fi (the fallback every online match through a strict NAT needs). A `relay failed` / failure popup instead = report the line (the Wi-Fi blocks the relay's UDP, or the service's TURN key / budget is off). Uses one of the account's 6 TURN credentials a day. PASS (tools/console-1.2/online_check.py <log> --run <id> reads it all): every STATE line of the route in order and `script exit`, no `[script] TIMEOUT`, no crash; the `[np-net] req` lines show every request ANSWERED by the service (an HTTP 2xx or the service's own JSON error with a code), no `trying the other address` line (either `[np-net]` or `[online]`: in an auto run one means the new address FAILED: report it), host=new on every request of an auto run, host=old in the old variant; at most 100 requests in any 10 s window (the zone's shared rule) and the requests per minute stay far below the service's daily budget; every pollScale / over_budget level / retryAfterSec the log shows is reported; the menu returns after the cancel. Needs a package built from agent/online24 (MSC_NET_REQLOG: before it the client logs no request line and the rules cannot be read).
